
  demo
  Full command reference — all groups expanded

  Core
    build                        # Compile the project
    ci                           # Full pre-push pipeline: lint, build, test
    test                         # Run the test suite
      -k <pattern>                 Filter tests by name pattern
      -w, --watch                  Re-run on file changes

  build  — Build
    build docker                 # Build the container image
    build release                # Build release artifacts

  deploy  — Deploy
    deploy production            # Deploy to production (requires approval)
    deploy staging               # Deploy to the staging environment

  tool  — Tools
    tool clean                   # Remove build output and caches
    tool doctor                  # Check that this checkout can run

  Tip: run `justz help build` for argument details
